lines.arrive: The long way home, along the boardwalk through the swamp.
lines.strike_1: Lightning. It takes you apart, all of you, in an instant.
lines.strike_2: And by sheer chance, at the same moment, it turns the dead tree into an exact copy of you. Every atom in place. Every memory.
lines.dog: The dog sniffs you for a long time. Then, slowly, it wags its tail.
lines.frogs: Two frogs on the lily pad, where there used to be one. They look at each other.
lines.home_idle: Your friend comes down to the path, to fetch you in.
lines.home_1: You go in. You know where the mugs are. You know your friend takes two sugars.
lines.home_2: Nobody will ever know the difference. Did you recognise your friend? Or did you only seem to?
lines.tell_1: Your friend doesn't believe a word of it.
lines.tell_2: Same face, same voice, same memories. Some people say that makes you the same person. Others say the one who walked into the swamp never came out.
lines.back_1: You go back to the swamp, to look for yourself. There's only a scorch mark, and the black water.
lines.back_2: Nobody else is coming home tonight. Only you. If it is you.
